annotations.title: UnFee Pre-Send Address-Poisoning & Lookalike Spoofing Guard

description: Pre-send address-poisoning & vanity prefix/suffix lookalike spoofing guard for Base (8453), Ethereum (1), and XRPL wallets. Detects attackers matching the first 3-6 and last 3-6 hex characters of a trusted counterparty while middle bytes differ.

recentContacts.description: Optional list of trusted/recent counterparty addresses to guard against lookalike spoofing

to.description: Destination wallet address to verify before signing

name: unfee_address_guard
